# Bulk Email Checker

Bulk Email Checker verifies email addresses in real time and reports deliverability, mailbox, domain, risk, and mail-server details.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bulk-email-checker/.

## Actions

- **Verify Email**: Verify one email address and return its deliverability result, reason, suggested correction, risk flags, mail-server enrichment, and…
